summary: Example tests a registered async poll result with is finished.
questions: How do I write an until loop for an async job?

answer_card.title: finished test example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- async_status: {jid: '{{ job.ansible_job_id }}'}
  register: asynctaskpoll
  until: asynctaskpoll is finished
  retries: 30
```
